items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: And of course Nicholas Payton being from New Orleans, I had him in mind when I wrote this piece.

ctx.x: So here we have a second line rhythm in an odd meter. So you can think about the barbecue part but with a little twist on it, you know, Q-B-Rab. So that’s kind of the connection with the title. And of course Nicholas Payton being from New Orleans, I had him in mind when I wrote this piece.
If a student was watching this interview and said a number of times you’ve mentioned the second line, they might not know what you’re talking about.
